data.Name: Gillian Krause
data.Title: Senior Director Product Marketing
data.Bio: Gillian Krause leads product marketing for Adobe Edge Delivery Services, driving the vision and go-to-market strategy for the platform. She specializes in translating complex technical capabilities into business value.

data.Name: Amol Anand
data.Title: Senior Product Manager
data.Bio: Amol Anand leads the technical direction for Edge Delivery Services. He works closely with enterprise customers to evolve the platform based on real-world use cases and scaling challenges.

data.Name: Darin Kuntze
data.Title: Senior Solutions Architect
data.Bio: Darin Kuntze is a Senior Solutions Architect with deep expertise in content management systems and web architecture. He specializes in scalable, performant solutions for global enterprises.

data.Name: Sagar Sane
data.Title: Solution Architect
data.Bio: Sagar Sane specializes in commerce integrations and headless commerce architectures for Edge Delivery Services. He helps customers build high-performance commerce experiences.

data.Name: Sean Steimer
data.Title: Senior Computer Scientist
data.Bio: Sean Steimer is a Senior Computer Scientist and one of the core architects of Edge Delivery Services. He focuses on clean code, performance optimization, and developer-friendly APIs.

data.Name: Kiran Murugulla
data.Title: Cloud Architect
data.Bio: Kiran Murugulla specializes in integrations and enterprise architecture for Edge Delivery Services. He is an advocate for API-first design and serverless architectures.

data.Name: Beaudon McLaren
data.Title: EDS Lab Participant
data.Bio: Beaudon is working through the EDS Masterclass labs with a focus on authoring workflows, block development, and data-driven pages. He is using the bmclaren branch and draft workspace to build and verify each exercise end to end.
